subject: Re: MedTech AI - RFP bake-off — trial credits & timing
messages:
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@medtechai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medtechai.com
Date: 2028-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MedTech AI RFP: bake-off timeline & request for trial credits

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking a look at our RFP. We're running a tight bake-off window with two other vendors and are trying to standardize test harnesses/metrics across all participants. Attached is the RFP packet with the evaluation criteria and sample data (MedTechAI_RFP.pdf).

Ask: would Redwood be able to provide an evaluation grant (trial credits) to cover a 2-week end-to-end benchmark (inference + embeddings + re-ranking)? Rough estimate: ~80k tokens for inference + 8k embedding units. We also may request a 1–2 week trial extension depending on finalist scheduling.

Key dates: kickoff week of Apr 24, scoring due May 10. Can you confirm what level of credit and any procurement steps you need from our side? Procurement is looped in.

Appreciate a quick read — we have a procurement freeze next Friday, so any signed paperwork before then would help us include Redwood in the finalist cohort.

Best,
Sarah Connors
Head of Applied ML
MedTech AI

Attachments: MedTechAI_RFP.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@medtechai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medtechai.com
Date: 2028-04-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedTech AI RFP: bake-off timeline & request for trial credits

Hi Sarah — thanks for the RFP and timeline. I read the packet; this is exactly the kind of evaluation Redwood prioritizes. Quick answers up front:

- We can commit an evaluation grant to support the bake-off. Tentative offer: 75k inference tokens + 10k embedding units + a 2-week trial window (can be extended by 1 week with a short approval).
- We will need a simple trial agreement signed (no long-term commitment). I attached our fillable approval form for procurement to speed approvals.
- Please share the scoring rubric and representative prompt set (or a subset) so we can ensure the trial configuration matches your eval harness.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement completes/returns approval_form_fillable.pdf (I attached).
2) Ben (CC) will propose the final credit envelope and internal ops routing.
3) Karthik (CC) will confirm any SLA/execution constraints and DocuSign link for the trial agreement.

If procurement needs an internal PO or SOW line-item, tell us the contact and timeline and we'll adapt. We want Redwood to be a smooth competitor here — especially on latency/cost tradeoffs you care about.

I can jump on a short call tomorrow afternoon if helpful.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: approval_form_fillable.pdf (fillable PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@medtechai.com>, procurement@medtechai.com
Date: 2028-04-12T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedTech AI RFP: bake-off timeline & request for trial credits

Olga / Karthik —

Per Olga's ask, here's the internal proposal to put forward to MedTech AI:

- Offer: 80,000 inference-token credit + 10,000 embedding units, valid for a 3-week window (kickoff Apr 24; expires May 15). We increased slightly from Olga's tentative to cover variance in token counts.
- Constraints: Credits apply only to evaluation endpoints in the dedicated trial project; no automatic rollover.
- Approval needed from sales ops for credits >$5k list, and legal for trial agreement redlines.

I attached a short approval form populated with the tentative amounts (approval_form_fillable.pdf). If Ops signs off I can provision the project and issue temporary API keys to Sarah's team.

Karthik — please confirm SLA language is acceptable and whether you need any special auditing logs for their compliance team.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Trials & Promotions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: approval_form_fillable.pdf (filled draft)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@medtechai.com>, procurement@redtechai.com
Date: 2028-04-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedTech AI RFP: bake-off timeline & request for trial credits

Ben / Olga —

Approve the credit envelope with one modification: authorize up to 100,000 inference tokens (buffer) and 12,000 embedding units, but require the following before provisioning:

- Signed trial agreement via DocuSign (no financial commitment beyond credits). See link: https://docusign.com/MT-AI-trial-agreement/XYZ123
- Confirmation that MedTech AI will provide the scoring rubric and a sanitized test subset prior to Apr 22 to configure batching/kv-cache optimizations.
- A one-sentence acceptance of our standard trial data handling clause (included in the DocuSign).

Once the DocuSign is signed and procurement returns the small approval form, Ops can provision the trial project and issue ephemeral keys. Ben — please route this to Ops; Olga — you can reply to Sarah to request the rubric.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
SVP, Sales Operations & Legal Liaison (acting)
Redwood Inference
